answer_1.quote: PoT aims to prompt Code Large Language Models (Code LLMs) to decompose complex problems into successive executable codes.

answer_2.quote: Remaining consistent with previous work, the metric is accuracy. For tasks whose ground truth are real numbers (Appl./Math), the answer is considered correct if its difference from the ground truth is less than 1e-3; for tasks with string-type ground truth (Date/Tabular/Spatial), the answer is considered correct only if it is exactly the same as the ground truth.
